written: 2026-11-01 commit c7038aa carries the exact time (the clock estimate written here was wrong), after development on 990721/990722 (117092, 600-960 and 1200-1560 s) and before any control window was evaluated
question: Do derived passes improve when extracted from the refined ball with actors/possession recomputed (app.tracking.ball_track.recompute_actors + passes.extract_passes), compared with the production derived passes?
method_frozen: refine_segment (ball track, default config) -> recompute_actors (build_frame rule, ACTOR_RADIUS_M) -> extract_passes on the segment's frames; passes are compared per segment window exactly as production does
ground_truth: SoccerTrack player_nodes touches with passSucceeded/passFailed (117092 mapping; 132877 mapping docs/measurements/ball-events-mapping-132877.json); a derived pass matches an event pass if |t| <= 1.5 s and start position within 6 m, one-to-one greedy by time

development_result.note: refined ball without actor recompute gives exactly the production passes (actors stale), so the actor recompute is the active ingredient

control.A: 990723: 117092 1800-2400 s (night), production frames vs frames_ball (already produced; actors recomputed by the frozen function at evaluation)

criteria_each_window.P1: recall (matched / gt passes): refined >= 2 x production
criteria_each_window.P3: defending-team accuracy (eval_defending_events / eval_telestration possession) with recomputed possession: refined >= refined-without-recompute - 3 points

decision: all pass in both windows -> telestrate_live re-derives passes from refined frames and the ingest replaces the segment's earlier video_passes/video_defensive_actions in the DB. Any failure -> actor recompute kept only where it does not harm (reported), passes not re-derived; code and criteria unchanged after the result.
